dogecoin.text: The new company will operate 9,000 DOGE mining rigs, making it one of the largest publicly traded companies focused on Dogecoin mining.

Dogecoin mining company Z Squared will go public through a merger with publicly traded biopharmaceutical company Coeptis (COEP), and the deal is expected to close in the third quarter of 2025. https://t.co/nEvanH330z

Nasdaq has filed an application with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to list and trade the 21Shares Dogecoin ETF, which is designed to track the performance of Dogecoin.
The ETF will be sponsored by 21Shares US LLC under Nasdaq Rule 5711(d). https://t.co/itvs8LJlfb
